title: Desaparecidos
goal: Read how enforced disappearance worked as a deliberate method, the disputed scale of it in Argentina, and how the Mothers of Plaza de Mayo turned grief into a lasting form of resistance.

items: Explain what enforced disappearance consisted of.
State the CONADEP figure and the disputed higher estimate.
Describe how the Mothers of Plaza de Mayo began in 1977.
Explain what happened to founder Azucena Villaflor.
Use aun cuando for a strong concession.
